entryPoints.title: Two Gateways to Public Sector Innovation
entryPoints.subtitle: Purpose-built workflows for government departments seeking solutions and startups ready to deploy

department.title: For Government Departments
department.desc: Formulate outcome-based challenges with pre-vetted legal templates, evaluate innovative solutions with expert panels, and run risk-managed sandbox pilots.

startup.title: For Innovative Startups
startup.desc: Overcome turnover/experience barriers with DPIIT relaxation rules, bid for structured government pilots, get guaranteed milestone payments, and secure scale-up contracts.
features: Zero prior turnover/experience penalty for DPIIT startups

loop.title: The End-to-End Innovation Procurement Lifecycle
loop.desc: A legally compliant, transparent route from initial problem framing to statewide procurement.

stages.name: Challenge Drafted
stages.desc: Dept formulates outcome-based need with KPIs & IP terms.

stages.name: Approved & Published
stages.desc: MSInS admin validates challenge quality & publishes publicly.

stages.name: Startup Discovery
stages.desc: Startups browse marketplace with AI match recommendations.

stages.name: Eligibility Screening
stages.desc: Rule engine applies DPIIT relaxations & flags review needs.

stages.name: Expert Evaluation
stages.desc: Independent expert panel scores proposals on weighted criteria.

stages.name: Pilot Design
stages.desc: Sandbox scope, milestone deliverables & payment terms finalized.

stages.name: Contract Signed
stages.desc: Standardized tripartite agreement locked with IP safeguards.

stages.name: Pilot Running
stages.desc: Startup deploys field pilot; live sensor/telemetry tracking.

stages.name: Independent Validation
stages.desc: Third-party validator certifies outcome KPI benchmarks.

stages.name: Payment Released
stages.desc: Milestone payment released with auto-delay tracking timers.

stages.name: Scale-up Decision
stages.desc: Scale statewide, extend pilot, or stop with documented learning.

scaledPilots.title: Recent Scaled Innovations in Maharashtra
scaledPilots.desc: High-impact pilots that successfully graduated from sandbox testing to departmental procurement.
